title: Genesis Theater

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Genesis Theatre is a high-quality performing arts facility operated by Delta School District, an ideal venue for concerts, dance, drama, lectures, and large presentations. Its mission is to support and promote local British Columbia performing artists; to build a community that supports the performing arts within Delta; and to develop a following of local patrons, in order to build support for the performing arts in our community. You can learn more about events at the Genesis Theatre by following this link: https://ce.deltasd.bc.ca/genesis-theatre/ Recently updated, Genesis Theatre is designed and equipped as a performing arts facility featuring: Genesis Theatre is available for Community

services.name: Rental Exception Dates
services.desc: While every attempt to facilitate rental requests will be made, there are certain dates in which the District requires use of their facilities and therefore will not be available to rent. Please note that the following groups are exempt: out-of-school daycare programs (Monday-Friday), Continuing Education classes, Parks & Recreation leisure services and churches (Sundays). User groups may continue to access the gym at their regular time if arrangements are made at the beginning of the booking for that school
